task_fulfillment.rationale: Both separate Word deliverables substantially address the request, and the Vendrax recommendation is supported by quoted cost and relative supply-lead-time advantages. Material corrections are needed before use: the email demands a fixed refund based on an unverified full upfront payment; the report nets off an unconfirmed recovery and directs its use as funding. Its categorical no-added-delay conclusion also relies on supply lead times despite unknown tooling and re-validation durations. The report's caveats and conditional nomination do not cure those operative assertions. Present payment and recovery cases separately, request 30% of the verified amount paid, and describe the six-week advantage as relative supply lead time rather than assured launch recovery. Page counts remain unverified, not established failures.
